facts.text: I asked for an explanation of the instrumentation and production choices in "The Whole World".
I never realized how complex the production was in "The Whole World".
I think the complex production adds to the overall impact of "The Whole World".
I think Outkast always managed to make socially conscious music while still being catchy and fun to listen to.
I think "The Whole World" is an exception to that pattern.
I love how "The Whole World" features Killer Mike's unique and powerful voice.
I think Killer Mike's voice adds another layer to the track.
I agree that "The Whole World" has energy that makes me want to dance and scream the lyrics.
I think Outkast and Killer Mike balanced the serious message with a fun sound in "The Whole World".
I think "The Whole World" is a song that never gets old for me.
I can listen to "The Whole World" on repeat for hours and never get tired of it.
